query:
SELECT tt.id, tt.amount, tt.reason, tt.balanceAfter, tt.createdAt, au.name, au.email, au.id as userId
FROM token_transactions tt
JOIN app_users au ON tt.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.name LIKE '%Linas%' OR au.email LIKE '%linas%'
ORDER BY tt.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
